posts.title: A table worth gathering around
posts.caption:
This is what showing up with Añejo looks like. 🌸

Cuban bites, trays for sharing and personal Cajitas, dressed for a celebration.

Planning a birthday, family gathering or team celebration? Tell us your date, city and guest count. We’ll help you choose the food and presentation, then confirm availability and your quote.

Explore Catering & Events through the link in our bio, or message us “CAJITA” to start the conversation.

Así se celebra con Añejo: sabor cubano, bandejas para compartir y Cajitas vestidas para tu ocasión. Escríbenos la fecha, ciudad y cantidad de invitados para cotizar.

¿Celebras en West Palm Beach, Lake Worth Beach o Boynton Beach? Cuéntanos tu ciudad para confirmar disponibilidad.

#CateringCubano #ComidaCubana #WestPalmBeach #LakeWorthBeach #BoyntonBeach

posts.title: Your occasion, your Cajita
posts.caption:
A little box. A thoughtful welcome. 🌸

La Cajita brings Cuban favorites together in individual packaging, with presentation coordinated to your celebration. Choose your colors, liners, labels, tags and finishing touches—and tell us which menu selections suit your guests.

Your menu, quantities and personalized details are confirmed with your quote. Standard orders need at least 48 hours; custom printing needs at least 72 hours and a reviewed quote.

Message us “CAJITA” with your event date, city and guest count, or choose Catering & Events in our bio.

Una Cajita para cada invitado. Cuéntanos tu ocasión y preparamos una cotización con el menú y la presentación que necesitas.

¿Planeas una celebración en Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood o Pembroke Pines? Comparte tu ciudad y revisamos disponibilidad.

#LaCajita #CateringCubano #FortLauderdale #HollywoodFL #PembrokePines

posts.title: Cajitas, trays, or both?
posts.caption:
Individual Cajitas or trays for the table? You can plan a celebration around either—or both.

Añejo brings Cuban flavor and considered presentation to birthdays, family gatherings and team events. Share your date, city, guest count and what you have in mind. We’ll confirm the menu, availability and quote before payment.

Start with Catering & Events in our bio, or message us “CATERING.”

¿Cajitas individuales o bandejas para compartir? Cuéntanos cómo quieres celebrar. La fecha, ciudad y cantidad de invitados nos ayudan a preparar tu cotización.

¿Tu evento es en Pompano Beach, Coral Springs, Miramar, Davie, Plantation o Sunrise? Envíanos la ciudad para confirmar disponibilidad.
